About

I am a PhD student in the UCLA Medical Imaging Informatics group, advised by Professor Alex Bui, and Professor Corey Arnold.

I am passionate about machine learning and deep learning, and their applications in clinical data and medical images. My primary project is to apply these techniques in predicting stroke patient brain tissue outcome and thereby providing insights to guide patient treatment.
